answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the vine of a task receipt, and the oasis is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the voyage is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
